found_at: https://github.com/prisma/presskit (Prisma's presskit, updated 2026-08 with the new logo; README 'Logo Mark')
edits: removed the white background rect (element 0) that sat behind the stripes, so the gaps between stripes are open as in prisma.io's own icon.svg
notes: The cyan/red/yellow stripes form a square: that square is the mark itself, not a background, so icon_check's coloured-canvas note is expected. The reviewer's 'verify company and mark' is answered: it is Prisma's current (2026) mark; the old dark prism triangle is retired. The white rect removal changes only the thin gaps between stripes, which now show the theme's background (as on prisma.io).
license: Prisma brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Prisma.
